method: Pearson + Spearman correlation, two-sided p-values; partial correlation controlling for literacy as a confounder check.
census_vintage: 2011 (crime 2016-2024) — population base is dated; rates are indicative

ethics.area_level_only: Ecological correlations between district aggregates. They say nothing about individuals (ecological fallacy).
ethics.not_model_features: No indicator here feeds any predictive model; ml/risk.py explicitly excludes caste/sex indicators.
ethics.protected_attributes_segregated: sc_share / st_share / sex_ratio are grouped as 'sensitive', flagged is_protected, and carry a mandatory caveat. Reported for transparency and disparity audit, never as a targeting signal.
ethics.reporting_caveat: FIR counts measure REPORTED crime, not true offending. Districts with better police access and higher literacy report more, which inflates their rate.

interpretation: Correlation is not causation. With n=30 only moderate+ effects are detectable; |r| < 0.3 is reported as negligible.
